articles.title: Why Qualcomm Shares Are Swinging After Handset Weakness And AI Data Center Push
articles.description: Qualcomm reported Q4 fiscal 2026 revenue of US$10.3b, with handset chip sales under pressure. Full year net income reached US$13.6b on US$43.1b in revenue, and management guided Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue to a range of US$10.4b to US$11.2b. The business is leaning harder into AI data center, automotive, and infrastructure deals, including the Dragonfly portfolio, an expanded automotive chip footprint, and long term agreements such as the SpaceX Starlink Mobile 5G partnership and custom silicon...

articles.description: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and SpaceX have agreed a multiyear partnership to power the new Starlink Mobile nationwide 5G network. The project uses Qualcomm 5G infrastructure technology at national scale, taking the chip designer beyond its traditional smartphone-focused business. Starlink Mobile aims to offer a satellite-backed 5G service across the U.S., creating a new competitor to existing wireless carriers.
